description.value:
Duration constant

Any Deadhand ability, effect, or Trade feature of yours that issues a command to one ally may target two allies instead. Both must be within the ability's range and must be able to hear and understand you. If the ability grants a bonus, both allies receive it; if it grants an action, each ally receives that action separately.

cinderfall.incomplete: Lets called commands that target one ally target two instead. The base "called command" mechanic itself has no rule-element footprint anywhere in this corpus (it ships purely through description, per the class-wide ACTIONCONV convention) -- there is nothing here for a doubling modifier to hook into.
